name: VCCNF Training Loop
definition: A training procedure for a Voxelized Continuous Coordinate Normalizing Flow (VCCNF) that learns to map Gaussian noise to shape latent codes conditioned on voxel data, using MSE loss.
summary: The VCCNF Training Loop is a supervised optimization procedure that learns to map Gaussian noise to shape latent codes conditioned on voxel data by minimizing the Mean Squared Error between predicted and target latent codes.
